Subject G.I. Umshanoff and V.I. Umshanoff, applicants for certificates of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C Crawford

1. Georgy Ivanovich UMSHANOFF, naturalized Chinese citizen of Russian origin, born on November 28, 1916 at Station Bukhedu, Chinese Eastern Railway. According to his own statement, he attended a Russian school in Harbin from 1928 to 1933, after which he resided at Station Bukhedu together with his parents for a period. Some time towards the end of 1934 he proceeded to Mukden where he was employed with Liddell Bros. & Co, Ltd, until August, 1937. He is reported to have arrived in Shanghai from Dairen in February, 1938, and to have since been employed as a mechanic with the Far Eastern Salvage Association, Ltd, 2 French Bund. He holds Residential Permit No 1, issued by the Mukden Police in 1938.

2. Vladimir Ivanovich UMSHANOFF, naturalized Chinese citizen of Russian origin, born on July 15, 1919 at Station Bukhedu, Chinese Eastern Railway. He is reported to have graduated from the First Russian Middle School at Harbin in 1936, after which he was employed with Liddell Bros. & Co, Ltd, at Mukden from September, 1936 to May, 1937, and with the Liaoning Press in the same city from December, 1937 to March, 1938. He arrived in Shanghai from Dairen in April, 1938 and is reported to have since been employed with the Far Eastern Salvage Association. He holds Residential Permit No 2 issued by the Mukden Police in 1938.

Until recently they are reported to have resided at 588 Yu Yuen Road. Their parents are reported to be residing at San Chao Ho, South Manchuria Railway, where the father, Mr. I.V. Umshanoff, is employed with the railway police.

Subject A.S. Merzlitsky, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Frokofiev Forwarded by C Crawford

Andrey Stepanovich MERZLITSKY, Russian, born on
September 2, 1894 at Kiev, Russia. He is reported to have
been formerly employed as a mechanic in the Russian Mercantile
Fleet. According to his own statement, he arrived in Chefoo
from Vladivostok on 2-1-1924 as a stowaway on board the s.s.
"Erivan". Later during the same year he proceeded to Shanghai.
Here he is reported to have been working as a mechanic in va-
rious local garages until 1926 or 1927 when he left for Nanking
where he was employed as a mechanic in the Chinese army for a
period. Returning to Shanghai some time towards the end of
1927 and continued to work as a motor car mechanic until 1929
when he joined the European Salvage Co, 24 The Bund, as a dri-
ver and mechanic. From January, 1932 to January, 1935 he worked
in the same capacity with the Far Eastern Salvage Co., and from
June, 1935 to 14-11-1938 - with the Far Eastern Salvage Associ-
ation, 2 French Bund.

He is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Com-
mittee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, and with the S.C.G. Police Bureau
(Reg. No. 2233 ) and at present resides at 918 Avenue Joffre,
House 6, together with his wife, Mrs Efrosinia Firsovna Merz-
litsky, born 20-7-1896 at Blagoveschensk, and their son, George
Andreyevich Merzlitsky, born 28-3-1920 at Vladivostok. Mrs Mer-
zlitsky ( formerly known as Mrs Ivanoff ) and her son are re-
ported to have arrived in Shanghai in 1924 from Vladivostok.
Merzlitsky junior studied in the French Municipal College and
later in the St. Joan of Arc's College for several years and
at present attends the Radio Operators' School of the Russian
Mercantile Marine Association, 12 Rue du Consulat.

A.S. Merzlitsky forms the subject of criminal re-

Andrey Stepanovich MERZLITSKY，俄罗斯人，1894年9月2日出生于俄罗斯基辅。据报他此前曾在俄罗斯商船队担任机械师。据其自述，他于1924年1月2日作为偷渡者乘坐“埃里温号”（Erivan）轮船从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达烟台。同年晚些时候，他前往上海。据报他在上海当地的多家汽车修理厂担任机械师，直到1926年或1927年离开前往南京，在那里他曾短期受雇于中国军队担任机械师。1927年底某时返回上海后，继续担任汽车机械师，直到1929年加入位于外滩24号的欧洲打捞公司（European Salvage Co），担任司机兼机械师。从1932年1月至1935年1月，他以相同身份在远东打捞公司（Far Eastern Salvage Co.）工作；从1935年6月至1938年11月14日，在位于法租界外滩2号的远东打捞协会（Far Eastern Salvage Association）工作。

他在莫尔尼路118/1号的俄罗斯侨民委员会以及特别市政府警察局（注册号 2233）登记，目前与妻子 Efrosinia Firsovna Merzlitsky 夫人（1896年7月20日出生于布拉戈维申斯克）及儿子 George Andreyevich Merzlitsky（1920年3月28日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克）同住于霞飞路918号6室。据报 Merzlitsky 夫人（原名 Ivanoff 夫人）及其子于1924年从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。小 Merzlitsky 曾在法公董局学校就读，随后在圣贞德学院（St. Joan of Arc's College）就读数年，目前在领事馆路12号的俄罗斯商船协会无线电操作员学校学习。

In May, 1928 he came to the notice of this office
as a suspected bolshevik agent and agitator. The suspicion
was due partly to the fact that he was employed in the Chi-
nese army at the time when the Kuomintang was still connect-
ed with Russian communists. It was also reported that he was
often visited by members of crews of Soviet ships, which came
to Shanghai, and that he openly expressed his bolshevik views.
No information has since been received which could substan-
tiate these suspicions. However, it of interest to note that
his son, G.A. Merzlitsky ( until recently known under the name
Ivanoff) is a member of the "Repatriation Union", a local
pro-Soviet organization, the professed aim of which is to ob-
tain for its members permission to return to the U.S.S.R.

Mrs. Merzlitsky and George A. Merzlitsky were is-
sued by the French Police on 18-11-38 with certificates of
good character ( Nos 179 and 181, respectively ).

Apart from the above there is nothing in the Muni-
cipal Police records concerning these persons.

Vladimir Grigorievitch STORCHILO, Russian, was born
on December 6, 1909, in Vladivostok, Maritime Province.
He is reported to have escaped from the U.S.S.R. to
Manchuria in May 1930. He arrived in Shanghai in the end
of the same year, and worked casually until the autumn of
1932 when he joined the Far Eastern Salvage Company as a
motorman and mechanic. He is still employed with this
company.

One of his brothers is at present serving with the
Russian Regiment S.V.C., and the other is a member of
the Russian Auxiliary Detachment, French Police.

The applicant is registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road and holds
passport No.15455 issued on 1-7-37 by the Police Bureau
of the City Government of Shanghai.

While in Shanghai, the applicant did not come to
the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any
activities of an undesirable nature.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by C. Crawford

Fedor Alexeyevich PERETIATKO, Russian, born on April
18, 1900 in Poltava Province, South Russia. According to his
own statement, he escaped from the U.S.S.R. to Japan in Janu-
ary, 1932 together with a group of other refugees from that
country and later proceeded to Mukden where he resided until
his departure to Shanghai. He arrived here from Dairen in
September, 1932 and from 13-10-32 to 31-10-37 served with
the Russian Regiment, S.V.C. Leaving the service on his own
wish and with a good testimonial he was employed as a mecha-
nic with the Far Eastern Slvage Association, 2 French Bund, from
April to October, 1938. On 10-10-38 he was engaged as a Tem-
porary Driver, Transport Office, S.M.Police, but was dismissed
on 24-10-38 for drunkenness. Since that time he has been un-
employed.

Peretiatko is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, and with the S.C.G. Police Bu-
reau (Reg. No. 13395 ) and at present resides at 613 Avenue
Joffre, House 25.

On 17-11-38 he obtained from the French Police a
certificate of good character ( No. 177 ).

Apart from the above there is nothing in the Muni-
cipal Police records concerning this individual.

A. Prokofiev

Fedor Alexeyevich PERETIATKO，俄罗斯人，1900年4月18日出生于南俄罗斯波尔塔瓦省。据其自述，他于1932年1月与一群来自该国的其他难民一起从苏联逃往日本，随后前往沈阳，在那里居住直至离开前往上海。他于1932年9月从大连抵达此处，并从1932年10月13日至1937年10月31日在俄罗斯团（S.V.C.）服役。出于自愿离职并获得良好的推荐信后，他于1938年4月至10月在位于法租界外滩2号的远东打捞协会担任机械师。1938年10月10日，他被聘为工部局警务处交通科的临时司机，但因醉酒于1938年10月24日被解雇。此后他一直失业。

Peretiatko 在莫尔尼路118/1号的俄罗斯侨民委员会以及特别市政府警察局（注册号 13395）登记，目前居住于霞飞路613号25室。

1938年11月17日，他从法国警察处获得品行证明书（编号 177）。

除上述情况外，工部局警务处档案中关于此人没有其他记录。

A. Prokofiev

Made by D. P. S. Pavloff. Forwarded by C. [Signature]

Nicolai Nicolaevitch PERMINOFF , Russian , was born
on December 12 , 1912 in Vladivostok , Maritime Province.
He is reported to have arrived in Harbin from Vladivostok
together with his mother in 1918. Following his mothers'
death in 1925 he left Harbin for Shanghai , arriving in this
city in 1926. Here he worked as an apprentice in various
car repair shops until 1929 when he left for Tsingtao where
he worked in the capacity of a chauffeur-mechanic. He
returned here in 1930 and in September of the same year
joined the International Funeral Directors as a driver. He
worked in this capacity until October 1931 when he joined
the Russian Regiment , S.V.C. , in which he served until
October 1932. Leaving the Regiment on his own accord he was
engaged as a driver by the late Doctor Shishlo. In June
1934 he obtained a position of a motorman and mechanic with
the Far Eastern Salvage Company , in which concern he worked
until, February 1936. In May of the same year he joined the
Italian Salvage Company where he worked until May 1937 when
the concern was liquidated.

On April 28 , 1938 he together with another Russian ,
one V. Ermolaeff , and Captain A. Petersen, American , sailed
from Shanghai to the U.S.A. in the Chinese junk named"Humel
Humel". The trip was a success and they reached San Pedro,
California in 122 days. However , as the applicant and the
other Russian did not have the necessary documents for entry
in the U.S.A. they were subsequently deported to Shanghai,
arriving here on November 11 , 1938.

The applicant is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee , II8/I , Moulmein Road.

尼古拉·尼古拉耶维奇·佩尔米诺夫（Nicolai Nicolaevitch PERMINOFF），俄罗斯人，1912年12月12日出生于滨海省符拉迪沃斯托克。据报他于1918年与母亲一起从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达哈尔滨。1925年母亲去世后，他离开哈尔滨前往上海，于1926年抵达该市。在这里，他在各种汽车修理厂当学徒，直到1929年离开前往青岛，在那里担任司机兼机械师。他于1930年返回此处，并于同年9月加入国际殡仪馆担任司机。他在此职位上工作到1931年10月，随后加入上海义勇队俄罗斯团，服役至1932年10月。他自愿离开该团后，受雇于已故的 Shishlo（音译）医生担任司机。1934年6月，他在远东打捞公司获得了一份马达驾驶员和机械师的职位，在该机构工作至1936年2月。同年5月，他加入意大利打捞公司，工作至1937年5月该机构清算为止。

1938年4月28日，他与另一名俄罗斯人 V. Ermolaeff（音译）以及美国人 A. Petersen（音译）船长一起，乘坐名为“Humel Humel”的中式帆船从上海驶往美国。这次航行很成功，他们在122天后抵达加利福尼亚州的圣佩德罗。然而，由于申请人和另一名俄罗斯人没有进入美国所需的必要文件，他们随后被驱逐回上海，于1938年11月11日抵达此处。

申请人在莫尔海姆路118/1号的俄罗斯侨民委员会登记。

Made by D. R. S. Pavloff. Forwarded by C. Sempill I. S.

Vladimir Alexeyevitch ARNOLAEF , Russian , was born
on April I , 1917 in Harbin , Manchuria. Upon graduating
from a local high school he went to Tientsin and resided
there for a period. He arrived in Shanghai in June 1937.
At the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities he joined
the Auxiliary Detachment of the French Police in which he
served until March 1938 when he resigned on his own accord.
On April 28 , 1938 he together with another Russian ,
one M.Permiakoff, and Captain A. Petersen , American , sailed
from Shanghai to the U.S.A. in the Chinese junk named "Hunol
Hunel". The trip was a success and they reached San Pedro,
California in 102 days. However, as the applicant and the
other Russian did not have the necessary documents for entry
in the U.S.A. , they were subsequently deported to Shanghai,
arriving here on November II , 1938 .
The applicant is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee , 118/I Moulmein Road.
There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
detrimental to his character.

（批：28/11）

A. G. Pavloff.
D. P. S.

Subject A. Fechischeff, applicant for a certificate of character

Made by D.P.S. Pavloff Forwarded by C. [Signature]

Alexander Vassilievitch FECHISCHEFF, Russian, was born on July 15, 1904 in Viatka, Russia. He is reported to have left Russia in 1921 and subsequently resided in Harbin, Manchuria. He first arrived in Shanghai in 1925 and during the general strike was employed as a fireman on board the s.s. "Luchow," from August 7, 1925 to October 16, 1925. Later he proceeded to Harbin, where in December 1926 he obtained a position with the Chinese Eastern Railway. In December 1933 he left that position and in the beginning of 1934 returned to Shanghai. During the same year he secured his present employment with the Lucerne Dairy Farm, 381 Great Western Road.

In July 1925 Fechischeff was the subject of a letter addressed to the Shanghai Municipal Police from the Detective Department of the Harbin Police, in which it was stated that prior to his leaving Harbin for Shanghai Fechischeff seduced one Russian female, named N. Shpakovsky, by promising to marry her and that when he left Harbin she had been pregnant for seven months. It was requested in the letter to advise Fechischeff, should he be located in Shanghai, to settle the matter with the female concerned, failing which, proceedings would be instituted against him in Court. It is believed that after returning to Harbin, the applicant settled this matter with Miss Shpakovsky and subsequently ~~was paying her an alimony~~ paid an allowance 15 ta. until she got married. At present he is under no obligations towards that female.

While in Shanghai he did not come to the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities of undesirable nature.

[Signature]
29/11.

D.C. (Special Branch).

A. G. Pavloff.
D. P. S.

亚历山大·瓦西里耶维奇·费奇谢夫（Alexander Vassilievitch FECHISCHEFF），俄国人，1904 年 7 月 15 日出生于俄罗斯维亚特卡。据报他于 1921 年离开俄罗斯，随后居住在满洲哈尔滨。他于 1925 年首次抵达上海，在大罢工期间，于 1925 年 8 月 7 日至 1925 年 10 月 16 日期间受雇为“卢州”号（s.s. "Luchow"）轮船上的司炉工。后来他前往哈尔滨，并于 1926 年 12 月在中东铁路获得了一个职位。1933 年 12 月他离开了该职位，并于 1934 年初返回上海。同年，他在大西路 381 号的卢塞恩奶牛场（Lucerne Dairy Farm）获得了目前的职位。

1925 年 7 月，哈尔滨警察局侦探科致信上海公共租界工部局警务处，提及费奇谢夫一事，信中指出，在费奇谢夫离开哈尔滨前往上海之前，他曾承诺娶一名名为 N. Shpakovsky 的俄国女子并诱奸了她，当他离开哈尔滨时，该女子已怀孕七个月。信中要求，如果在上海找到费奇谢夫，应劝告他与该女子解决此事，否则将对他提起诉讼。据信，申请人返回哈尔滨后，与 Shpakovsky 小姐解决了此事，随后 ~~支付她赡养费~~ 向她支付津贴 15 两，直到她结婚。目前他对该女子不再负有任何义务。

在上海期间，他未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

[签名]
11/29.

A. G. Pavloff.

on April 27, 1906 in Don Region , Russia. He is reported

of Saghalin Island in 1932 and later proceeded to Mukden.

in December of the same year obtained a position as a

on the 19th of the same month secured his present position as a
diver with Mollers' Limited.

The applicant is registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee , 118/1 Moulmein Road.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
detrimental to his character.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch Station /
REPORT
Date December 3, 1938
Subject V.P. Sudareff, applicant for a certificate of character
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. S.I.

Vassily Petrovich SUDAREFF, Russian, born on Decem-
ber 15, 1893 at Moscow. According to his own statement, he
left Russia for Manchuria in 1920 together with the remnants of
the Siberian "white" army and subsequently resided in Harbin
where from 1920 to 1923 he was employed at the Chinese Eastern
Railway. For the following two years he attended a school of
the Church of Seventh Day Adventists in Harbin, after which he
was engaged in missionary work in Manchuria on behalf of the
church until 1933 as a "licensed worker". From 1933 to 1937 he
resided at Bukhedu, Chinese Eastern Railway, being engaged in
farming.

In August, 1937 he arrived in Shanghai from Tsingtao
and has since been residing at 686 Avenue Joffre together with
his family consisting of his wife, Mrs Anna Diomidovna Sudareff,
born 3-2-1893 at Moscow, and their children: Lydia ( b.1923 at
Harbin), Nina ( b. 1927 at Hailar ), Ludmila ( b.1929 at Pogran-
nichnaya, C.E.R. ), Pavel ( b. 1930 at Mukden ) and Peter ( b.
1933 at Kuanchendzy, S.M.R. ).

Mr. and Mrs Sudareff are registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, Coulmein Road, and hold certificates of
good character issued by the French Police on 26-11-38 ( Nos
187 and 188, respectively ).

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records con-
cerning these persons.

It appears that the local branch of the Seventh Day
Adventists' Mission, in the activities of which Mr. Sudareff has
been participating since his arrival in Shanghai, will assist
him financially and otherwise in the matter of migrating to
Australia.

报告
日期：1938年12月3日
事由：V.P. Sudareff，品行证明书申请人
由警探长 Prokofiev 呈报。经高级督察 C. Crawford 转呈。

瓦西里·彼得罗维奇·苏达列夫（Vassily Petrovich SUDAREFF），俄国人，1893年12月15日出生于莫斯科。据其自述，他于1920年随西伯利亚“白”军残部离开俄国前往满洲，随后居住在哈尔滨，1920年至1923年间受雇于中东铁路。此后的两年里，他就读于哈尔滨基督复临安息日会学校，之后作为教会的“持证工作人员”在满洲从事传教工作直至1933年。1933年至1937年，他居住在中东铁路的布赫杜（Bukhedu，音译），从事农业耕作。

1937年8月，他从青岛抵达上海，此后与家人一直居住在霞飞路686号。其家庭成员包括妻子安娜·迪奥米多夫娜·苏达列夫夫人（Mrs Anna Diomidovna Sudareff），1893年2月3日出生于莫斯科；以及他们的子女：莉迪亚（Lydia，1923年生于哈尔滨）、尼娜（Nina，1927年生于海拉尔）、柳德米拉（Ludmila，1929年生于中东铁路波格拉尼奇纳亚站 Pogranichnaya, C.E.R.）、帕维尔（Pavel，1930年生于奉天 Mukden）和彼得（Peter，1933年生于南满铁路宽城子 Kuanchendzy, S.M.R.）。

苏达列夫夫妇已在穆尔明路（Coulmein Road）的俄国侨民委员会登记，并持有法国警察于1938年11月26日签发的品行良好证书（编号分别为187和188）。

工部局警务处档案中并无关于这些人的记录。

据悉，苏达列夫先生抵沪后一直参与活动的基督复临安息日会本地分会，将在其移居澳大利亚一事上给予他财政及其他方面的协助。

Subject Maxim Tzytovich, applicant for a certificate of character.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.S.

Maxim Alexandrovich TZYTovich, Russian, born on October 22, 1907 in Amur Province, Russia. According to his own statement, he left Russia for China in 1923 and for about two years resided at Pogranichnaya Station, Chinese Eastern Railway, where his father, a Soviet citizen, was employed in the Russian Customs. From 1925 to 1931 he studied in the Harbin Polytechnic Institute. Upon graduating, he proceeded to Shanghai, arriving in this city in September, 1931. Here he worked for various periods with different local enterprises including Volta Electric Company, 654 Avenue Joffre ( 1932-1933), Russian Broadcasting Association ( 1934-1935) and R.C.A. Victor Co. in China ( 1935-1936). From 1936 he is reported to have been employed with Williams Audio Engineering Co, 681 Bubbling Well Road.

Prior to leaving Harbin in 1931 he renounced his allegiance to the Soviet Government and took out emigrant papers. He and members of his family are registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee, Moulmein Road, and with the S.C.G. Police Bureau and at present reside at 611 Rue Bourgeat, House 14.

Mrs Taissia Anatolievna Tzytovich née Kurcheyeff, Russian, was born on October 19, 1909 at Irkutsk, Siberia. She is reported to have arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in September, 1935 and to have since been employed as a teacher in the St. Tichon's Orphanage, French Concession. She married Mr. Tzytovich in October, 1937.

Mrs Evdokia Gerassimovna Kurcheyeff née Kletneff, mother-in-law of Mr. Tzytovich, was born on March 1, 1881 in Simbirsk Province, Russia. She has been residing in Shanghai together with her daughter since 1935.

马克西姆·亚历山德罗维奇·齐托维奇（Maxim Alexandrovich TZYTovich），俄国人，1907年10月22日出生于俄国阿穆尔省。据其自述，他于1923年离开俄国前往中国，并在随后的约两年时间里居住在中东铁路波格拉尼奇纳亚站（Pogranichnaya Station），其父为苏联公民，当时在俄国海关任职。1925年至1931年，他在哈尔滨工业大学就读。毕业后，他前往上海，于1931年9月抵达本市。在此期间，他曾断续受雇于多家本地企业，包括霞飞路654号的伏打电气公司（Volta Electric Company，1932-1933年）、俄罗斯广播协会（Russian Broadcasting Association，1934-1935年）以及在华的 RCA 胜利公司（R.C.A. Victor Co.，1935-1936年）。据报道，自1936年起，他受雇于静安寺路681号的威廉斯音频工程公司（Williams Audio Engineering Co）。

1931年离开哈尔滨之前，他宣布放弃对苏联政府的效忠，并办理了侨民证件。他和他的家人已在穆尔明路（Moulmein Road）的俄国侨民委员会以及特别市政府警察局（S.C.G. Police Bureau，注：此处可能指法租界或特定机构缩写，依原文保留）登记，目前居住在布尔热瓦路（Rue Bourgeat）611弄14号。

泰西娅·阿纳托利耶夫娜·齐托维奇夫人（Mrs Taissia Anatolievna Tzytovich），娘家姓库尔切耶夫（Kurcheyeff），俄国人，1909年10月19日出生于西伯利亚伊尔库茨克。据报道，她于1935年9月从哈尔滨抵达上海，此后一直在法租界圣蒂洪孤儿院（St. Tichon's Orphanage）担任教师。她于1937年10月与齐托维奇先生结婚。

叶夫多基娅·格拉西莫夫娜·库尔切耶夫夫人（Mrs Evdokia Gerassimovna Kurcheyeff），娘家姓克莱特涅夫（Kletneff），系齐托维奇先生的岳母，1881年3月1日出生于俄国辛比尔斯克省。自1935年以来，她一直与女儿一起居住在上海。

Shanghai, 25th. November, 1938.

Major K.M. Bourne.
The Commissioner
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Sir,

For the past six years I served in the Shanghai
Municipal Police resigning from the Force on April
15th 1938.

Now I am planning to go to Australia to settle
down there. I applied for application at the H.M.
British Consulate.

They gave me an application to fill up, but
one of the clause of application contains: (10)
Neither I nor any member of my family has ever been
in prison or in mental Hospital. (To be supported by
a certificate from a Police Officer or other public
official).

I should much obliged to you, if you would kindly
grant me a letter to this effect.

Thanking you in advance,

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

B.T. Bombenfo.

Boris Fedorovich COSUBENKO-BORITZ, Russian, born on
July 24, 1905 at Vladivostok, Russia. According to his own state-
ment, he left Vladivostok for Manchuria in 1922 and for the fol-
lowing 8 years resided at Harbin where he was employed with the
Produce Export Company ( 1922-1927 and 1928-1929 ) and with
A. Lopato Sons, Ltd ( 1927-1928 and 1929-1930 ).

In April, 1930 he arrived in Shanghai from Harbin. Here
he worked casually until October 15, 1932 when he joined the S.M.
Police as a Probationary Sergeant. He resigned from this service
on 14-4-38, the date of expiration of his long leave. Subsequently
he opened a small provision store in Rue Paul Henry. The business
proved to be a failure after a few months. At present he is re-
ported to be working in the printing department of the "Shanghai
Times."

It would appear that his resignation from this Force
was due to the fact that he had incurred a number of debts and
was unable to meet the demands of his creditors. Latest informa-
tion indicates that he is still pressed by his creditors and that
several persons who acted as his guarantors in his financial
transactions have been obliged to meet their obligations owing
to Cosubenko's failure to pay his debts. This has caused con-
siderable damage to his reputation.

On discharge from the Police he was given a good charac-
ter and since that time did not come to the notice of the Muni-
cipal Police in connection with any activities of an undesirable
nature.

In July, 1938 when filling in a registration form in the
Russian Emigrants' Committee, Moulmein Road, he stated that he

鲍里斯·费奥多罗维奇·科苏本科-博里茨（Boris Fedorovich COSUBENKO-BORITZ），俄国人，1905年7月24日出生于俄国符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）。据其自述，他于1922年离开符拉迪沃斯托克前往满洲，并在随后的8年里居住在哈尔滨，期间受雇于农产品出口公司（Produce Export Company，1922-1927年及1928-1929年）以及 A. Lopato Sons, Ltd 公司（1927-1928年及1929-1930年）。

1930年4月，他从哈尔滨抵达上海。在此处他打零工，直到1932年10月15日加入工部局警务处担任试用巡长。他于1938年4月14日辞职，这一天也是他长期假期的结束之日。随后，他在保罗·亨利路（Rue Paul Henry）开了一家小食品店。几个月后生意失败。据报道，他目前在《上海泰晤士报》的印刷部工作。

看来他辞去警队职务的原因是他欠下多笔债务，无力偿还债权人的要求。最新信息显示，他仍受到债权人的催逼，且几位在其财务交易中担任担保的人因科苏本科未能偿还债务而被迫履行义务。这对其声誉造成了相当大的损害。

在离开警队时，他获得了品行良好的评价，此后并未因任何不良行为引起工部局警务处的注意。

riods as a shop assistant with various local stores including
the "Palais des Modes", Avenue Joffre, Data Shoe Co., Ltd, Mar-
cel Confectionery. From 1935 she has been employed as a book-
keeper with the Foreign Y.M.C.A., Bubbling Well Road.

制作人：副督察 Prokofiev。转呈人：C. Crawford [手写签名]

Galina Antonovna VOLICHENKO 小姐，俄裔归化中国公民，1915年2月23日出生于俄罗斯滨海省哈巴罗夫斯克。她自幼居住在哈尔滨，其已故父亲曾在楚林公司（Churin & Co.）任职。1931年6月，她毕业于该市的多斯托耶夫斯基中学，随后一年在长春的方济各会修女寄宿学校就读。

1932年11月，她从哈尔滨抵达上海。据报，1934年和1935年间，她曾在多家本地商店短期担任店员，包括霞飞路的“时尚宫”（Palais des Modes）、大达鞋业有限公司、马塞尔糖果店。自1935年起，她受雇于静安寺路的外国青年会，担任簿记员。

Volichenko 小姐持有外交部于1933年5月18日签发的第003999号中国护照，以及法国警察机关于1938年11月15日签发的品行良好证明（编号 3019/A）。她在莫尔尼路俄国侨民委员会登记，目前与其母亲 A.L. Shabalin 夫人（娘家姓 Lensky，据报为离异人士）同住于格鲁希路51号3号住宅。

工部局警务处档案中没有任何关于 Volichenko 小姐的记录。

A. Prokofiev

concerning Mr. M. Utujnikoff, applicant for a visa to enter Australia.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev    Forwarded by C. Crawford S.J.

Mihail Ilyich UTUJNIKOFF, Russian, born on June
4, 1913 in Amur Province, Siberia.    According to his
own statement, he escaped from the U.S.S.R. to Manchuria
in 1925 together with his father and sister.    From
1925 to December, 1930 he attended the St. Louis College
at Tientsin and upon graduating studied in the Peking
National University ( Foreign Languages Department) for
several months.

In February, 1932 he arrived in Shanghai and for
about four months attended the Shanghai Business College,
Kiukiang Road.    On November 1, 1932 he joined the French
Police as a Garde Auxiliaire, in which capacity he served
until May, 1936, when he was discharged owing to his
unfitness for police work.    He received a certificate
from the French Police to the effect that during the period
of his service he was not reprimanded for any serious
offence and that his morals and conduct were always good.

From October, 1936 to January, 1937 he was employed
with the Lien Hwa Tobacco Company, 1 The Bund.    Leaving
this firm on his own wish and with a good testimonial, he
was without any fixed employment until the spring of 1938 when
he started to work for the North China Daily News as a
reporter.    He left this position on November 1, 1938 to
join the crew of the "Mei-Ling", a Chinese junk, owned by
an American named Nichols which sailed from Shanghai to
San-Francisco on 2-11-38.    About the middle of November
last the junk was wrecked near the Pescadores Islands,
following which the trip was abandoned.    Utujnikoff

Mihail Ilyich UTUJNIKOFF，俄国人，1913年6月4日出生于西伯利亚阿穆尔省。据其自述，他于1925年与父亲和妹妹一起从苏联逃往满洲。1925年至1930年12月，他就读于天津圣路易斯学院，毕业后在北京国立大学（外语系）学习了数月。

1932年2月，他抵达上海，并在九江路的上海商学院就读了约四个月。1932年11月1日，他加入法国警察队担任辅助警卫（Garde Auxiliaire），在此职位上服务至1936年5月，后因不适合警务工作而被解职。他获得了法国警察队出具的证明，称其在服役期间未因任何严重过失受到训斥，且品德和行为一直良好。

1936年10月至1937年1月，他受雇于外滩1号的联华烟草公司。他是自愿离开该公司的，并持有良好的推荐信，此后直到1938年春季之前没有固定工作，随后开始在《字林西报》担任记者。他于1938年11月1日辞去该职位，加入一艘名为“美龄”号的中式帆船的船员队伍，该船由一名叫 Nichols 的美国人所有，于1938年11月2日从上海驶往旧金山。去年11月中旬，该帆船在澎湖群岛附近失事，随后航程中止。Utujnikoff

November 1, 1938

To Whom it may concern:

Mr. L. E. Utujnikoff has worked in the editorial department of
the "North-China Daily News" for the past seven or eight months. His
duties have covered general reporting work, especially waterfront and
shipping news. We have found him a very willing and useful reporter,

Constantin Grigorievich VASSILIEFF, Russian, was
born on March 1, 1891 at Kazan, Russia. Former student of the
Polytechnic Institute at Petrograd ( 1915 ) he is reported to
have arrived in Shanghai from the U.S.S.R. via Harbin in 1924.
Here he worked with various local architects until 1926, after
which he has been working independently as a consulting engi-
neer and building contractor with offices at 119 Route de Crou-
chy ( 1926-1927 ), 695 Avenue Joffre ( 1928-1930 ), 9-A Hankow
Road ( 1930-1934 ). In 1934-1935 he was a partner of the firm
Vassilieff & Donin Co, 110 Szechuen Road ( Woodworking Factory ).

In 1932 when the "Russian Technical Society" was
formed in Shanghai, he was elected Chairman of this organiza-
tion and has since been its member.

He is registered with the Council of United Rus-
sian Public Organization ( SORO ), 8 Avenue Dubail, and with the
Shanghai City Government Police Bureau ( Reg. 6667 ). Until
April, 1938 he resided at 241/2 Route des Soeurs and his pre-
sent address is Room 150, Foreign Y.M.C.A., Bubbling Well
Road.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records con-
cerning this person.

A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

Constantin Grigorievich VASSILIEFF，俄国人，1891年3月1日出生于俄罗斯喀山。据报道，他曾是彼得格勒理工学院的学生（1915年），并于1924年经哈尔滨从苏联抵达上海。在此地，他为多位本地建筑师工作至1926年，此后作为咨询工程师和建筑承包商独立执业，办公室地址依次为：格鲁希路119号（1926-1927年），霞飞路695号（1928-1930年），汉口路9-A号（1930-1934年）。1934-1935年，他是四川路110号瓦西里耶夫与多宁公司（木器厂）的合伙人。

1932年上海成立“俄罗斯技术协会”时，他当选为该组织主席，并此后一直为其成员。

他在杜美路8号的俄罗斯公共组织联合会（SORO）和上海市政府警察局登记（注册号 6667）。直至1938年4月，他居住在修女路241/2号，目前的地址是静安寺路外国青年会150室。

工部局警务处档案中没有任何关于此人的记录。

A. Prokofiev

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. [Signature] A. J.

Pavel Alexandrovich BOIKO-SOKOLSKY, Russian, born on
February 16, 1899 at Nikolsk-Ussuryisk, Maritime Province,
Russia. According to his own statement, he left Russia for
Manchuria in 1918 and was employed at a power station at
Handaohedzy, Chinese Eastern Railway, from 1921 to 1925,
after which he left for Shanghai. After about three months
residence here he proceeded to Tientsin where from 1925 to
1929 he was employed at the Gayety Cinema. From 1929 to
1932 he worked for the Star Film Co. in Harbin and from 1932
to September, 1938 resided at Hankow where he was employed
with various cinema theatres and other enterprises as a
supervisor of sound equipment etc.

He arrived in Shanghai from Hankow via Hongkong on
20.9.38 in the s.s. "Chenonceaux" and is at present residing
at 307 Route Vallon together with his wife, Mrs. Maria
Leopoldovna Boiko-Sokolsky nee Auman, born 4.12.1911 at
Barabash, Maritime Province, Russia, and their son Herman,
born 15.12.1931 at Harbin. Mrs. Boiko-Sokolsky arrived in
Shanghai from Hankow via Hongkong on 15.10.38 in the s.s.
"Athos II."

Mr. and Mrs. Boiko-Sokolsky hold passports issued
by the Hankow Police Bureau on 9.9.38 (No. 812) and 12.8.38
(No. 767), respectively.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning these persons.

G. Prokopiev
D.S.I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

Pavel Alexandrovich BOIKO-SOKOLSKY，俄罗斯人，1899 年 2 月 16 日出生于俄罗斯滨海省乌苏里斯克（Nikolsk-Ussuryisk）。据其自述，他于 1918 年离开俄罗斯前往满洲，1921 年至 1925 年间受雇于中东铁路横道河子（Handaohedzy）发电站，随后前往上海。在此居住约三个月后，他前往天津，1925 年至 1929 年间受雇于盖蒂电影院（Gayety Cinema）。1929 年至 1932 年，他在哈尔滨明星电影公司（Star Film Co.）工作；1932 年至 1938 年 9 月，他居住在汉口，受雇于多家电影院及其他企业，担任音响设备监管等职。

他于 1938 年 9 月 20 日乘坐“谢农索号”（s.s. "Chenonceaux"）轮船经香港从汉口抵达上海，目前与其妻子 Maria Leopoldovna Boiko-Sokolsky（婚前姓 Auman，1911 年 12 月 4 日出生于俄罗斯滨海省巴拉巴什 Barabash）及儿子 Herman（1931 年 12 月 15 日出生于哈尔滨）共同居住在万隆路（Route Vallon）307 号。Boiko-Sokolsky 夫人于 1938 年 10 月 15 日乘坐“Athos II 号”轮船经香港从汉口抵达上海。

Boiko-Sokolsky 夫妇分别持有汉口警察局于 1938 年 9 月 9 日（第 812 号）和 1938 年 8 月 12 日（第 767 号）签发的护照。

工部局警务处档案中无关于此二人的记录。

G. Prokopiev

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Gaudio

Ivan Moiseyevich ( or Ivan Mihailovich ) DZUBENKO,
Russian, born on January 19, 1900 in Kiev Province, Russia. Accord-
ing to his own statement, he left Russia for China in 1919 and
for the following seven years resided in Harbin where he was em-
ployed at the Sungari Mills as a foreman, fireman and locksmith.
In 1926 he proceeded to Canada. Returning to Harbin in 1928, he
continued to work at the Sungary Mills for about one year and
subsequently was employed as an assistant engineer at Mukden,
Chinese Eastern Railway for a period. In November, 1930 he ar-
rived in Shanghai from Harbin. Here he was employed with China
Record Co., 1099 Route de Zikawei, as a fitter from 22-11-30 to
6-4-33. Some time towards the end of 1933 he left for Tsingtao
where, according to him, he stayed until July, 1937, after which
he proceeded to Tientsin.

On or about November 1, 1938 he arrived in Shanghai
from Tientsin. He resided at 93 Route Remi until November 26,
after which he removed to 153 Avenue Haig, House 5. At present
he is reported to be employed with the Oriental Engineering &
Plumbing Co, 1550 Avenue Joffre ( Lincoln Apartments ).

When registering with the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
Boulmein Road, in November, 1930 he stated that he was married
and gave his wife's name as Olga Ivanovna Belgaus. It appears
that in 1936 or 1937 they were divorced and that shortly after-
wards Dzubenko married one Maria Petrovna Marasina, born 9-1-1896
at Kazan.

Dzubenko holds passport No 2238/3c5689 issued on
21-10-38 by the Public Safety Bureau at Tientsin, good for tra-
velling to the Netherlands Indies and Canada. Upon arrival here
he applied to the Netherlands Consulate-General for a visa for

Ivan Moiseyevich（或 Ivan Mihailovich）DZUBENKO，俄罗斯人，1900 年 1 月 19 日出生于俄罗斯基辅省。据其自述，他于 1919 年离开俄罗斯前往中国，随后七年在哈尔滨居住，受雇于松花江面粉厂（Sungari Mills），担任领班、司炉和锁匠。1926 年他前往加拿大。1928 年返回哈尔滨后，继续在松花江面粉厂工作约一年，随后在沈阳中东铁路担任助理工程师一段时间。1930 年 11 月，他从哈尔滨抵达上海。在此期间，他于 1930 年 11 月 22 日至 1933 年 4 月 6 日间，受雇于徐家汇路 1099 号的中国唱片公司（China Record Co.），担任装配工。1933 年底左右，他前往青岛，据称在那里停留至 1937 年 7 月，之后前往天津。

他于 1938 年 11 月 1 日左右从天津抵达上海。他居住在雷米路（Route Remi）93 号直至 11 月 26 日，随后搬至海格路（Avenue Haig）153 号 5 室。据悉，他目前受雇于霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）1550 号（林肯公寓）的东方工程与水暖公司（Oriental Engineering & Plumbing Co）。

1930 年 11 月在慕尔鸣路（Boulmein Road）俄罗斯侨民委员会登记时，他声称已婚，并给出其妻姓名为 Olga Ivanovna Belgaus。看来他们在 1936 年或 1937 年离婚，不久后 Dzubenko 娶了 Maria Petrovna Marasina，她于 1896 年 1 月 9 日出生于喀山。

Dzubenko 持有天津公安局于 1938 年 10 月 21 日签发的第 2238/3c5689 号护照，有效期涵盖前往荷属东印度和加拿大的旅行。抵达此地后，他向荷兰总领事馆申请

fused owing, it is reported, to the fact that blank passports of
the Nanking Government which are in possession of the new autho-

    Mr. and Mrs Dzubenko hold certificates of good cha-

    There is nothing in the Municipal Police records con-

    According to an unconfirmed report received by the
French Police recently, Dzubenko is likely to have been connect-
ed in some way with certain members of the "Anti-Communist Com-
mittee" in Tientsin, whose names figured prominently in connection
with police investigations of the murder of a Russian named Con-
stantin Voronin in February, 1938, in Tientsin. The investigations
were conducted by the Municipal Police of the British Concession.
As it is impossible to either prove or disprove this allegation
by local enquiries, this report is given here under every re-
serve.

Grigory Matveyevitch KRIVOROOCHKO, Russian, was
born on November 8, 1881 in Transbaikal Province, Siberia.
Upon graduating from the Imperial University in Tomsk in
1910 he was employed as a physician of the Russian Navy at
Vladivostok, and from 1916 to 1920 he was the head of the
Sanitary Administration of Transbaikal Province. In 1920
he arrived in Harbin and for the following ten years
practised medicine in that city. He was also a staff
physician of the Italian Consulate, Fire Brigade and the
Greek community in Harbin. He arrived in Shanghai in 1930
and at present has his office at 551 Weihaiwei Road, Apt.
B-02. Since 1932 he has been holding the rank of Lieutenant
in the F.V.C. (Medical Services).

Mrs. Serafima Davidovna KRIVOROOCHKO, nee DVORKINA,
Russian, was born on February 3, 1891 in Mogilev, Russia.
She married the applicant in 1907 and has since been residing
together with him. They have a son, M. Krivoroochko, an
electro-mechanical engineer, who at present is employed with
the General Electric Company of China in Hongkong.

The applicant is registered with the Russian Emigrants
Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
detrimental to the characters of above persons.

〔此处有手写签名及缩写 D. P. S.〕

D.C. (Special Branch)

〔左下角有手写批注及印章，内容难以辨认〕

Grigory Matveyevitch KRIVOROOCHKO，俄罗斯人，1881 年 11 月 8 日出生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省。1910 年毕业于托木斯克帝国大学后，他在符拉迪沃斯托克担任俄罗斯海军军医，1916 年至 1920 年间担任外贝加尔省卫生局局长。1920 年他抵达哈尔滨，并在该市行医十年。他还担任意大利领事馆、消防队以及哈尔滨希腊社区的驻院医生。他于 1930 年抵达上海，目前诊所在威海卫路 551 号 B-02 室。自 1932 年以来，他在志愿团（F.V.C.，医疗服务）中拥有中尉军衔。

Serafima Davidovna KRIVOROOCHKO 夫人（婚前姓 DVORKINA），俄罗斯人，1891 年 2 月 3 日出生于俄罗斯莫吉廖夫。她于 1907 年与申请人结婚，此后一直与其共同居住。他们育有一子 M. Krivoroochko，是一名机电工程师，目前受雇于香港的通用电气公司（General Electric Company of China）。

申请人已在慕尔鸣路 118/1 号俄罗斯侨民委员会登记。

工部局警务处档案中无不利于上述人员品行的记录。

Subject D.V. Lachinoff, applicant for a certificate of character.
Made by J.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Gaspari

Dmitry Vassilievich LACHINOFF, Russian, was born on
September 27, 1905 at Harbin. Son of the late Mr. V.D. Lachinoff,
former manager of the Chinese Eastern Railway, he is reported
to have graduated from the Harbin Polytechnic Institute in 1932.
In December of the same year he arrived in Shanghai. Here he
was employed as a refrigerating engineer with York Shipley Co.,
11 Jinkee Road, from 20-9-33 to 1-10-37 when his services were
dispensed with owing to lack of business on account of the Sino-
Japanese hostilities. From 25-4-38 to 20-11-38 he was tempo-
rarily employed as a works engineer with Shanghai Ice & Cold
Storage Co., 138 Nanking Road. He holds good testimonials from
the above two firms.

Lachinoff is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, Loumain Road, and with the S.M.P. Police Bureau
( Reg. No. 9478 ) and at present resides at 485 Rue Lafayette,
Apt. 304 together with his mother, Mrs V.D. Lachinoff, 57, and
his junior brother, S.V. Lachinoff, who is employed in the Pub-
lic Works Department of the French Municipal Council. Appli-
cant's sister is the wife of Mr. A.T. Down, British, of Anderson,
Meyer and Co.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records con-
cerning this person.

A Prokofiev
J. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).
P. A. to D. ( Sp. Br. )

Dmitry Vassilievich LACHINOFF，俄国人，1905 年 9 月 27 日出生于哈尔滨。他是已故 V.D. Lachinoff 先生之子，其父曾任中东铁路经理。据称他于 1932 年毕业于哈尔滨工业大学。同年 12 月他抵达上海。此后，他在金基路 11 号的 York Shipley 公司担任制冷工程师，任期从 1933 年 9 月 20 日至 1937 年 10 月 1 日，后因中日敌对行动导致业务匮乏而被解雇。从 1938 年 4 月 25 日至 1938 年 11 月 20 日，他在南京路 138 号的上海冰厂冷藏公司临时担任工厂工程师。他持有上述两家公司的良好推荐信。

Lachinoff 已在霞飞路的俄国侨民委员会以及工部局警务处警察总局（注册号 9478）登记，目前与母亲 V.D. Lachinoff 夫人（57 岁）及弟弟 S.V. Lachinoff 居住在拉斐德路 485 号 304 室，其弟受雇于法公董局工务处。申请人的姐姐是英籍人士 A.T. Down 先生的妻子，Down 先生在安达生·梅耶公司任职。

工部局警务处档案中关于此人没有任何记录。

A Prokofiev

Subject A.S. Utujnikoff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev    Forwarded by C. Gasko

Ilya Savvich ( A.S. ) UTUJNIKOFF, Russian, was born on July 23, 1886 at Aksha, Transbaikal Province, Siberia. According to his own statement, he studied medicine at the Military Medical Academy in St. Petersburg until 1906. Towards the end of 1925 he escaped from the U.S.S.R. to Manchuria together with his son and daughter. After a short stay in Harbin he proceeded to Tientsin where he resided until 1931, after which he left for Peking. Early in 1932 he arrived in Shanghai and has since been residing in this city working as a medical practitioner. Prior to the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in 1937 he had his office in Wayside district, and at present - in the Foo Ming Hospital Clinic, 45/11 Great Western Road. His name is not included in the Shanghai Municipal Council's register of approved medical practitioners and it appears that he is not in possession of a doctor's diploma.

Utujnikoff is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee, Route Joffre, and with the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau ( Reg. No. 14472 ). At present he resides at 741 Rue Ratard, Apt. 39.

He holds a certificate of good character issued by the French Police on 9-12-38 ( No. 194 ).

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records concerning this person.

A. Prokofieff
D. S. I.

（左侧手写批注及签名）
D. C. ( Special Branch)

Ilya Savvich ( A.S. ) UTUJNIKOFF，俄国人，1886 年 7 月 23 日出生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省阿克沙。据其自述，他在圣彼得堡军事医学院学习医学直至 1906 年。1925 年底，他与儿子和女儿一起从苏联逃往满洲。在哈尔滨短暂停留后，他前往天津，在那里居住至 1931 年，随后前往北平。1932 年初他抵达上海，此后一直居住在该市，从事医疗执业。在 1937 年中日敌对行动爆发前，他的诊所在西区，目前在Great Western Road（大西路）45/11 号的福民医院诊所。他的名字未列入上海公共租界工部局注册医师名录，看来他并未拥有医生文凭。

Utujnikoff 已在霞飞路的俄国侨民委员会以及上海市政府警察局（注册号 14472）登记。目前他居住在辣斐德路 741 号 39 室。

他持有法国警察于 1938 年 12 月 9 日签发的品行良好证明书（编号 194）。

工部局警务处档案中关于此人没有任何记录。

A. Prokofieff
D. S. I.

（左侧手写批注及签名）

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev    Forwarded by C. Crawford [签名]

Ilya Efimovich ROSENZWEIG, Russian of Jewish origin,
was born on May 27, 1878 in Vilno Province, Russia. He
is reported to have graduated from the Medical Faculty of
the University of Berlin in 1905 and subsequently to have
obtained a doctor's diploma at the University of Moscow
(1906). According to his own statement, he arrived in
Harbin from Vladivostok in February, 1925 and for the
following four years was in charge of the Surgical Depart-
ment of the Central Hospital of the Chinese Eastern Railway
in that city.

Some time towards the end of 1929 he arrived in
Shanghai from Harbin travelling on a Soviet passport.
Shortly afterwards he renounced his allegiance to the
Government of the U.S.S.R. and took out emigrant papers
through the medium of the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
118/1 Moulmein Road.

While in Shanghai Dr. Rosenzweig practised medicine
and is known as one of the leading Russian surgeons here.
He is a member of the Russian Medical Society and at
present has an office at R. 313-317 Hamilton House,
Kiangsi Road, residing at 1202 Avenue Joffre, Flat 62.

David Ilyich ROSENZWEIG, son of the above, was born
on October 14, 1907 at Riazan, Russia. He left the
U.S.S.R. for Manchuria together with his father and is
reported to have subsequently resided in Harbin until
1928, after which he proceeded to Canada where, according
to him, he studied at the University of Alberta, Edmonton,
Alta (Structural Engineering Department). In September,

Ilya Efimovich ROSENZWEIG，犹太裔俄国人，1878 年 5 月 27 日出生于俄罗斯维尔诺省。据称他于 1905 年毕业于柏林大学医学院，随后在莫斯科大学获得医生文凭（1906 年）。据其自述，他于 1925 年 2 月从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达哈尔滨，并在随后的四年里负责该市中东铁路中央医院的外科部门。

1929 年底左右，他持苏联护照从哈尔滨抵达上海。不久之后，他放弃了对苏联政府的效忠，并通过摩尔门路 118/1 号的俄国侨民委员会办理了侨民证件。

在上海期间，Rosenzweig 医生行医，并被认为是这里领先的俄国外科医生之一。他是俄国医学会成员，目前诊所在江西路汉密尔顿大厦 R. 313-317 室，居住在霞飞路 1202 号 62 室。

David Ilyich ROSENZWEIG，上述人之子，1907 年 10 月 14 日出生于俄罗斯梁赞。他与父亲一起离开苏联前往满洲，据称随后在哈尔滨居住至 1928 年，之后前往加拿大，据他说，他在阿尔伯塔省埃德蒙顿的阿尔伯塔大学（结构工程系）学习。9 月，

1932 he arrived in Shanghai from Canada and shortly
afterwards was engaged by Davies, Brook & Gran, 81

with which firm he is still employed. He resides with

    Until 1928 Rosenzweig-junior is reported to have

of good character. (Nos. 199 and 200, respectively).
    There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning these persons, except that on 11.10.35, when
giving his verdict in H.B.M. Court at the inquest on the
late Mr. N. Widler, Mr. Haines, sitting as Coroner,
commented adversely on Dr. Rosenzweig's action in the
case in question. In the opinion of the Coroner, Dr.
Rosenzweig ought never to have issued a death certificate
in the terms he did and ought to have notified the police
of the suspicious cause of death. Failure on the part of
Dr. Rosenzweig to comply with the latter request made it
impossible to determine the cause of death of Mr. N.
Widler.

1932 年他从加拿大抵达上海，不久后受雇于金基路 81 号的 Davies, Brook & Gran 公司（建筑师、测量师和土木工程师），目前仍受雇于该公司。他与父亲同住。
    据称，小 Rosenzweig 在 1928 年之前一直是苏联公民。在上海，他在摩尔门路的俄国侨民委员会登记。
    Rosenzweig 医生及其儿子持有护照（编号 711 和 712），于 1938 年 7 月 21 日在汉口签发，适用于前往澳大利亚、巴勒斯坦、欧洲、加拿大和美国。1938 年 12 月 22 日，他们从法国警察处获得了品行良好证明书。（分别为编号 199 和 200）。
    工部局警务处档案中关于这些人没有任何记录，除了在 1935 年 10 月 11 日，在英国陛下法院对已故 N. Widler 先生的死因审讯中，担任验尸官的 Haines 先生对 Rosenzweig 医生在该案中的行为提出了负面评论。验尸官认为，Rosenzweig 医生根本不应以他所出具的方式签发死亡证明，而应就可疑的死因通知警方。Rosenzweig 医生未能遵守后一项要求，使得无法确定 N. Widler 先生的死因。

                                        A. Prokofieff

Mrs Nina Andreyevna FILIPPOFF nee Nasukoff-Nasukov-
sky, Russian, was born on July 10, 1912 in Tomsk Province, Sibe-
ria. According to her own statement, she escaped from the
U.S.S.R. to Manchuria in 1933 and for the following three
resided at Harbin. In September, 1936 she arrived in Shanghai
from Harbin. Here she has been working as a ladies' dress ma-
ker.

When registering with the Russian Emigrants' Commit-
tee, Boulmein Road, she stated that she was married, but that
she had been living separately from her husband since 1934. Her
three years old son is with her parents in Harbin.

Mrs Filippoff is registered with the Shanghai City
Government Police Bureau (Reg. 18275 ) and holds a certificate
of good character issued by the French Police on 13-12-38
(No. 196 ). At present she resides at 129 Avenue Haig, Apt. 11.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records con-
cerning this person.

G. Prokofiev.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. Crawford

Mihail Grigorievich KOJEVNIKOFF, Russian, was born
on November 7, 1901 in Orenburg Province, Russia. According
to his own statement, he served in the ranks of the white
army in Siberia for a period and left Russia for Siberia
in 1920 together with the remnants of the army, after which
from 1920 to 1934 he was employed with the Chinese Eastern
Railway in various capacities. He claims to have received
a training in electro-mechanical work in 1922-1923. From
1934 to February 1935, he resided in Tientsin, after which
he proceeded to Shanghai. Here he remained until August of
the same year, during which period he is known to have
been employed with the China General Omnibus Co., as a
ticket inspector for about 2 months. In August, 1935 he
left for Tsingtao where he is reported to be conducting
a boarding house at 6 Hwei Chuan Road. He arrived in
Shanghai from Tsingtao on 13.12.38 in the s.s. "Dairen Maru"
and at present resides at 713 Avenue Joffre.

While in Harbin, he applied for a Soviet passport
in order, he stated, to keep his employment. Upon his
arrival in Shanghai in 1935 he registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, Moulmein Road, on the strength of
emigrant passport No. 472 issued on 31.3.35 in Tientsin
for travelling to Saigon. At present he holds passport
No. 4705 issued on 6.11.38 by the Peace Maintenance Committee
in Tsingtao. He also is in possession of permit to enter
New Zealand issued at Wellington, N.Z., on 22.9.38
(No. C.33/133/232) and an affidavit issued by the British
Consulate in Tsingtao in lieu of passport to enable him to

Mihail Grigorievich KOJEVNIKOFF，俄罗斯人，1901年11月7日出生于俄罗斯奥伦堡省。据其自述，他曾在西伯利亚的白军中服役一段时间，并于1920年随残部离开俄罗斯前往西伯利亚，此后从1920年至1934年间，他在中东铁路担任各种职务。他声称在1922-1923年间接受过机电工作培训。从1934年到1935年2月，他居住在天津，随后前往上海。在此地他一直停留到同年8月，在此期间，据悉他曾在中国公共汽车公司担任查票员约两个月。1935年8月，他前往青岛，据报道他在汇泉路6号经营一家寄宿公寓。他于1938年12月13日乘坐“大连丸”号轮船从青岛抵达上海，目前居住在高乃依路713号。

在哈尔滨期间，他申请了苏联护照，据称是为了保住工作。1935年抵达上海后，他凭1935年3月31日在天津签发的前往西贡的移民护照（编号472）在穆伦路俄罗斯侨民委员会进行了登记。目前他持有1938年11月6日由青岛治安维持会签发的护照（编号4705）。他还持有1938年9月22日在新西兰惠灵顿签发的进入新西兰的许可证（编号 C.33/133/232），以及英国驻青岛领事馆签发的一份代替护照的宣誓书，以便他能够

REPORT    Date October 10, 1938.

Subject Certificates of character and requests by the
Australian Trade Commissioner

Made by **〔此处转录不清〕** and Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

In a number of requests received by this office
from the Australian Trade Commissioner's office for all
particulars regarding certain persons who have visited
the office of the Commissioner it has been found that the
people mentioned in the requests have no intention of
leaving for Australia and only visited office for
information as to procedure on entry to Australia and
conditions prevailing there at present. When enquiries
have been made those people have stated that they have
no intention of leaving this city at present which has
resulted in useless trips being made by detectives
attached to this branch.

It is respectfully suggested that the Australian
Trade Commissioner give instructions to his staff to
inform applicants to apply to the Police for certificates
and on all certificates issued a copy of the Police
report could then be forwarded to their office thereby
obviating the sending out of requests for information
of persons who have no intention of going to Australia.

The procedure in the Commissioner's office is
to ask the name card of all persons enquiring and on
those name cards the requests for information are based.

C. Crawford
D. I.

在本办公室收到澳大利亚贸易专员办公室发来的多份请求，要求提供某些曾访问专员办公室的人员的全部详细资料。经查发现，这些请求中提到的人并无前往澳大利亚的意图，访问办公室仅是为了了解进入澳大利亚的程序及当地目前的状况。在进行查询时，这些人表示目前无意离开本市，导致本股所属侦探进行了无谓的外勤调查。

谨建议澳大利亚贸易专员指示其工作人员，告知申请人直接向警方申请证明书，并在签发所有证明书后，将警务报告的副本 forwarded 至其办公室，从而避免向那些无意前往澳大利亚的人员发出信息查询请求。

专员办公室的程序是索取所有查询者的名片，并基于这些名片提出信息查询请求。

Gregory Alexandrovich POTAPOFF, Russian, born
on January 5, 1903 at Semipalatinsk, Akmolinsk Province,
Siberia. Former cadet of the Omsk Military Cadet School
he arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok in 1922 together
with the school. From 1925 to 1928 he is reported to
have been employed with L.E. Hudec, local architect, and
from 1929 has been in the service of the Shanghai Muni-
cipal Council ( Public Works Department). At present he
holds the position of a clerk of works. According to
his own statement, he intends to resign from this ser-
vice in November, 1939.

He is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, Boulmein Road. In November, 1938 he obtained
a divorce from his first wife ( maiden name Lusa G. Yan-
kovsky ) and in December of the same year married one
Mrs Zoia Emilievna Bruderer, 36, who also was recently
divorced from her first husband, a certain Mr. G.A. Sis-
tonen.

Mr. and Mrs Potapoff reside at 37/107 Brenan
Road. They hold passport No. 100166 issued on 25-3-39 by
the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Chungking Govern-
ment, good for travelling to Chile via the United States.
They were issued by the Municipal Police on 21-2-38 and
21-4-39, respectively, certificates of character in con-
nection with their intention to proceed to Chile.

While in Shanghai they did not come to the notice
of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities
of an undesirable character.

D.C. ( Special Branch)
A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

Gregory Alexandrovich POTAPOFF，俄国人，1903年1月5日出生于西伯利亚阿克莫林斯克省塞米巴拉金斯克。前鄂木斯克陆军士官学校学员，1922年随该校从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。据报，1925年至1928年间受雇于本地建筑师 L.E. Hudec，自1929年起服务于上海公共租界工部局（工务处）。目前担任监工员一职。据其本人陈述，他打算于1939年11月辞去该职。

他在蒲石路俄侨委员会登记。1938年11月，他与第一任妻子（婚前姓 Lusa G. Yankovsky）离婚，同年12月与 Zoia Emilievna Bruderer 女士结婚，女方36岁，近期也与其第一任丈夫 G.A. Sistonen 先生离婚。

Potapoff 夫妇居住在勃南路37/107号。他们持有重庆政府外交部于1939年3月25日签发的第100166号护照，有效期为经美国前往智利。鉴于他们打算前往智利，警务处于1938年2月21日和1939年4月21日分别向他们签发了品行证明书。

Subject. OTTO TAUDIEN - applicant for appointment in the Shanghai
Municipal Police (Specials)
Made by. D.S. Hide Forwarded by. C. Crawford S.I

Otto Taudien, an applicant for appointment
in the Shanghai Municipal Police (Specials) is a
registered British subject who was born in Hongkong
on April 28, 1913. His mother was a native of
Canton whilst his father was Captain Hugo Taudien,
a German who, on April 26, 1934, was sentenced to
death for having participated in the piracy of the
s.s. "Sheng An" during June, 1933.

The applicant was educated at the Diocesan
High School for Boys in Hongkong which he attended
from the age of seven to sixteen years. He arrived
in Shanghai about six years ago and has since operated
the Taudien Mills (formerly the Oriental Flour
Mills) at 798, Ferry Road.

Nothing detrimental is known regarding the
applicant and the records of the Shanghai Municipal
Police and the French Police contain no reference
to him.

Tudhoe

〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写批注，包含 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH No. S. A D. Date 等字样〕

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Boris Michael Shick
has applied to this Consulate General for a visé for admission
into the Netherlands Indies.

The applicant, who is the owner of the Photoshop "Josepho",
situated at 957 Avenue Joffre and 61 Nanking Road, is born at
Vilna, Russia, on March 14, 1890, and registered with the
French Police at Shanghai.

According to his statement he will leave at the end of this
month for Hongkong and Singapore where he intends to remain
for two months. Afterwards he wishes to visit the Netherlands
Indies, and return to Shanghai.

He is already in possession of a certificate issued by the
British Consulate General at Shanghai for travelling to Hongkong,
and will apply for a Hansen passport.

The purpose of his trip is stated to be business.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 624/38 Divisi. 38 Date October 16, 1938）

Subject B.M. Shick, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [签名]

Boris Mihailovich SHICK, Russian Jew, was born on March 14, 1890 at Vilno, Russia. According to his own statement, he graduated from the University of Kiev ( Law Faculty ) in 1911 and saw active service in the ranks of the Russian Army during the Great War from 1914 to 1915 and later served in Admiral Kolchak's "white" army in Siberia for a period.

He arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok in November, 1922. In January, 1923 he established the "B and B" Photo Studio, which he conducted for the following two years. In 1925 he joined Josepho Studio as a partner and during the same year proceeded to Tientsin and Peking in order to establish branches. He remained at those towns until 1929, when he left for Mukden and established a similar business. Following the Mukden incident, 1931, he liquidated his business and returned to Shanghai in October of the same year. In February, 1932 he became the sole proprietor of Josepho Photo Studio at present holding premises at 61 Nanking Road and 937 Avenue Joffre.

He is registered with the Council of United Russian Organization (SORO), 8 Avenue Dubail, and at present resides at 345/6 Avenue du Roi Albert together with his wife, Mrs Mina Vladimirovna SHICK nee SMOLIANSKY, born 5-4-1894 at Poltava, South Russia, and their son Victor, aged 13, who at present attends a local school.

Mrs Shick's son by her first husband, Mr. Issac GOLDFIELD, born 25-12-1913 at Odessa, Russia, resides at 937 Avenue Joffre and has been employed at his step-father's photo studio since 1932 when he left the Marist Brothers School at Tientsin.

Mr. and Mrs Shick and Mr. Goldfield hold certificates of character issued by the French Police on 30-9-38 ( Nos 128,

Boris Mihailovich SHICK，俄籍犹太人，1890年3月14日出生于俄罗斯维尔诺。据其自述，他于1911年毕业于基辅大学（法律系），并在第一次世界大战期间（1914年至1915年）在俄罗斯军队中服役，后来在西伯利亚的科尔察克海军上将的“白军”中服役一段时间。

他于1922年11月从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达上海。1923年1月，他创办了“B and B”照相馆，经营了两年。1925年，他作为合伙人加入 Josepho 照相馆，并于同年前往天津和北平设立分店。他在这些城市停留至1929年，随后前往沈阳开展类似业务。1931年“九一八”事变后，他清算了业务，并于同年10月返回上海。1932年2月，他成为 Josepho 照相馆的唯一所有者，目前经营场所位于南京路61号和霞飞路937号。

他在杜拜尔路8号的俄罗斯联合组织委员会（SORO）注册，目前与妻子 Mina Vladimirovna SHICK（婚前姓 SMOLIANSKY，1894年4月5日出生于俄罗斯南部波尔塔瓦）及13岁的儿子 Victor（目前就读于当地一所学校）居住在阿尔伯特王路345/6号。

Shick 夫人与前夫所生之子 Issac GOLDFIELD 先生，1913年12月25日出生于俄罗斯敖德萨，居住在霞飞路937号，自1932年离开天津玛利斯特兄弟会学校以来，一直受雇于其继父的照相馆。

Shick 夫妇及 Goldfield 先生持有法国警察于1938年9月30日签发的品行证明书（编号 128、

INFORMATION REGARDING QUOTA IMMIGRATION VISAS.
(for persons desiring to go to the United
States to reside permanently)

GENERAL:
Before taking any action in connection with the obtain-
ing of a quota immigration visa, the applicant should
determine whether he comes under any of the classes which
are exempt from the quota restrictions. Information regard-
ing the nonimmigrant and nonquota classes will be furnished
upon inquiry at the Passport Office of this Consulate
General, Room 409, Development Building, 181 Kiangse Road.

EVIDENCE OF ALIEN'S QUALIFICATIONS FOR SELF SUPPORT:
The applicant should present letters from his employers,
an officer of a bank, or other responsible local residents,
who are disinterested, giving information, based on their
personal knowledge, regarding the applicant's character,
occupation, past employment, ability, earning capacity, cash
resources, value of property, and extent of encumbrances and
obligations.

AFFIDAVITS OF SUPPORT:
If the applicant will depend to any degree for support
upon relatives or other persons in the United States, such
persons should send to the applicant for presentation to
the Consulate General, evidence of their ability and willing-
ness to contribute to his support. Such affidavits should
advisedly contain items such as the following:
1.- Affiant's income, stating separately his salary,
interest, dividends, etc.
2.- Affiant's resources, including real estate,
personal property, bank balance, value of stocks
and bonds, cash surrender value of life insurance
policies.
3.- Affiant's obligations; for example, encumbrances
against real estate, and loans secured by stocks,
bonds, insurance policies.
4.- Affiant's annual expenses and margin of savings.
5.- Number of persons dependent upon affiant and
their relationship to him.
6.- Number of rooms in affiant's home, and whether
space is available for housing the applicant.
7.- Extent of obligation which affiant undertakes
toward the applicant; portion of affiant's
annual savings which he is willing to contribute
in this way.
8.- Extent to which the affiant has contributed to
the applicant's support in the past.
9.- Reasons for the affiant's desire to undertake
the applicant's support, in the absence of any
direct obligation to do so.
10.- Number and names of other applicants, if any, on
whose behalf the affiant has executed affidavits
of support.

EVIDENCE CORROBORATING AFFIDAVITS OF SUPPORT:
It is advisable that affidavits of support be accompanied
by corroborative evidence, such as the following:

关于限额移民签证的信息。
（适用于希望前往美国永久居住的人士）

一般事项：
在申请限额移民签证之前，申请人应确定自己是否属于不受限额限制的任何类别。关于非移民和非限额类别的信息，可向本总领事馆护照办公室（江西路181号发展大楼409室）查询获取。

外国人自给能力的证明：
申请人应提交来自其雇主、银行官员或其他无利害关系的当地负责任居民的信件，基于个人了解提供关于申请人品格、职业、过往就业经历、能力、收入能力、现金资源、财产价值以及抵押和义务程度的信息。

资助宣誓书：
如果申请人在某种程度上依赖美国的亲属或其他人提供资助，这些人应向申请人发送证据，证明其有能力并愿意为其提供资助，以便提交给总领事馆。此类宣誓书建议包含以下项目：
1.- 宣誓人的收入，分别列明其薪水、利息、股息等。
2.- 宣誓人的资产，包括房地产、个人财产、银行存款、股票和债券价值、人寿保险单的现金退保价值。
3.- 宣誓人的债务；例如，房地产上的抵押，以及以股票、债券、保险单担保的贷款。
4.- 宣誓人的年度开支和储蓄结余。
5.- 依赖宣誓人生活的人数及其与宣誓人的关系。
6.- 宣誓人家中的房间数量，以及是否有空间容纳申请人居住。
7.- 宣誓人对申请人承担的义务程度；其愿意以此方式贡献的年度储蓄部分。
8.- 宣誓人过去对申请人资助的程度。
9.- 在没有任何直接义务的情况下，宣誓人希望承担申请人资助的原因。
10.- 宣誓人已为其签署资助宣誓书的其他申请人（如有）的数量和姓名。

佐证资助宣誓书的证据：
建议资助宣誓书附带佐证证据，例如以下内容：

pages.en:
- 2 -

Affidavits of responsible disinterested persons
having personal knowledge of the facts set forth in
the affidavit of support.
Notarized letter of employer on business stationery,
showing length of employment, nature of position,
weekly wages paid, and permanency of position.
Notarized letter from officer of bank showing date
when an account was opened, the average monthly
balance, and current balance.
Certified copy of latest Federal Income Tax Return.
Real estate tax receipts.
Letter from insurance company showing cash surrender
value of policy.
Report of financial agency, public accountant, or
bank, (if affiant is in business), showing assets,
liabilities, profits, credit standing.
Letter from broker showing market value of stocks
and bonds.

FORMAL APPLICATION:
When the applicant is informed that his formal applica-
tion will be received, he should call in person at the
Passport Office of the Consulate General, bringing with him
his passport or other travel document, two certified copies
of his birth certificate, four photographs of himself, about
2 x 2 inches in size, on thin paper, with a light background,
and a medical certificate on a form provided by the Consulate
General. Two copies each of the applicant's prison and
military record, where available, should also be presented.
Other documents may be required if necessary for the determi-
nation of the applicant's identity and admissibility.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
Before submitting to physical examination, the applicant
should ascertain whether the certificate of the physician by
whom he wishes to be examined is acceptable to the Consulate
General. Names of physicians whose certificates are gener-
ally acceptable will be supplied to applicants upon inquiry.

FEES:
The fee for executing the application is U.S.$1.00
and the fee for the visa is U.S.$9.00. Payment may be made
in United States currency or in local currency. Checks
cannot be accepted.

REQUEST FOR QUOTA NUMBER:
Each visa must be given a number from the immigration
quota of the country in which the applicant was born, regard-
less of the country of his allegiance. The Consulate General
is the Control Office for the China quota only. For applicants
chargeable to other quotas, it is necessary to obtain quota
numbers from American consular offices elsewhere. Requests for
numbers will be made by letter or by telegraph. Telegraph
charges must be paid by the applicant.

VALIDITY OF VISAS:
Visas are ordinarily valid for four months. If a visa
cannot be used before its expiration, a new visa may be issued
during the same quota year under the same quota number, upon
payment of new fees and presentation of evidence showing that
the applicant is still qualified.

由对担保宣誓书中所述事实有亲身了解的、负责任的无利害关系人士出具的宣誓书。
雇主使用商业信笺出具的公证信函，注明雇佣期限、职位性质、周薪及职位的永久性。
银行官员出具的公证信函，注明开户日期、月平均余额及当前余额。
经认证的最近一期联邦所得税申报表副本。
房地产税收据。
保险公司出具的信函，注明保单的现金退保价值。
财务代理机构、公共会计师或银行出具的报告（如宣誓人从商），注明资产、负债、利润及信用状况。
经纪人出具的信函，注明股票和债券的市场价值。

正式申请：
当申请人获知其正式申请将被受理时，应亲自前往总领事馆护照办公室，携带其护照或其他旅行证件、两份经认证的出生证明副本、四张本人照片（尺寸约2 x 2英寸，薄纸，浅色背景），以及一份使用总领事馆提供表格填写的体检证明。如有申请人的监狱记录和服役记录，也应各提交两份副本。如有必要为确定申请人身份和准入资格，可能还需要其他文件。

体格检查：
在接受体格检查之前，申请人应确认其希望接受检查的医师所出具的证书是否为总领事馆所接受。经查询，将向申请人提供其证书通常被接受的医师名单。

费用：
办理申请的费用为1.00美元，签证费用为9.00美元。可用美国货币或当地货币支付。不接受支票。

配额号码申请：
无论申请人的效忠国为何，每份签证都必须根据申请人出生国的移民配额给予一个号码。总领事馆仅为中国配额的管控机构。对于计入其他配额的申请人，需从其他地方的美国领事机构获取配额号码。号码申请可通过信函或电报提出。电报费用由申请人支付。

签证有效期：
签证通常有效期为四个月。如果签证在到期前未能使用，在同一配额年度内，在缴纳新费用并提交显示申请人仍符合资格的证据后，可按同一配额号码签发新签证。

Date November 7, 19 38.

Subject K.A. Koostoff, applicant for a certificate of character.

Made by D.P.S. Pavloff Forwarded by C. __________

Kirill Andreyevitch KOOSTOFF, Russian, was born on
April 21, 1897 in Tomsky Province, Siberia. He arrived in
Harbin from Vladivostok in 1919 and soon afterwards joined
Alexandre Gutbezahl, Trading Corporation, Fur and Skin Dealers.
He had been working for the above firm for over 18 years, when
on June 1, 1938 he had to resign owing to the closure of the
Harbin Branch of the said concern. During his employment
with the firm in 1927 he was granted 9 months leave which he
spent in the U.S.A.

In June 1938 he left Harbin for Tientsin and arrived
in Shanghai from that city in the s.s. "Lushan Maru" on
October 16, 1938.

The applicant is registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road. He holds
travelling passport No.00188 issued on October 5, 1938 by the
Bureau of Public Safety of Greater Tientsin.

Maria Vasilievna KOOSTOFF, nee Kouznetzoff, Russian,
was born in Tver, Russia, on July 7, 1905. She is reported
to have resided in Harbin since her childhood as her father
was connected with the Chinese Eastern Railway. She married
the applicant in 1926.

While the applicant and his wife were visiting
America, a daughter was born to them at San-Francisco,
California on August 1, 1927. This girl is an American Citizen
by birth and holds passport No.E 179329, issued on June 21,
1938 by the American Consulate General in Harbin.

There is nothing in Municipal Police records concerning
any of these persons.

D.C. (Special Branch)

M. G. Pavloff.
D. P. S.

由 D.P.S. Pavloff 制作 由 C. ___ 转呈

Kirill Andreyevitch KOOSTOFF，俄罗斯人，1897年4月21日出生于西伯利亚托木斯克省。他于1919年从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达哈尔滨，不久后加入 Alexandre Gutbezahl 贸易公司（皮草商）。他在上述公司工作了18年多，直到1938年6月1日，由于该公司哈尔滨分行关闭，他不得不辞职。在该公司任职期间，他于1927年获准休假9个月，期间在美国度过。

1938年6月，他离开哈尔滨前往天津，并于1938年10月16日乘坐“庐山丸”轮（s.s. "Lushan Maru"）从该市抵达上海。

申请人已在莫尔尼姆路（Moulmein Road）118/1号的俄罗斯侨民委员会登记。他持有天津特别市警察局于1938年10月5日签发的第00188号旅行护照。

Maria Vasilievna KOOSTOFF，娘家姓 Kouznetzoff，俄罗斯人，1905年7月7日出生于俄罗斯特维尔。据报，由于其父亲与中东铁路有关联，她自幼居住在哈尔滨。她于1926年与申请人结婚。

当申请人及其妻子访问美国时，他们的女儿于1927年8月1日出生于加利福尼亚州旧金山。该女孩因出生而获得美国公民身份，并持有美国驻哈尔滨总领事馆于1938年6月21日签发的第E 179329号护照。

工部局警务处档案中没有任何关于这些人的记录。

D.C. （特务科副科长）

M. G. Pavloff.
D. P. S. （特务科副巡官）

Date November 8, 1938

Subject E.A. Nasonoff, applicant for certificate of character.

Made by D.P.S. Pavloff Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Evgeny Alexandrovitch NASONOFF, Russian, was born
in Perm, Russia on February 17, 1896. He is reported to
have left Russia in 1920 and subsequently resided in Harbin.
In December 1927 he graduated from the 1st School of Den-
tistry in Harbin and established himself as a dental surgeon.
In December 1932 he obtained a diploma of a dental surgeon
from the 2nd School of Dentistry in Harbin. From November
3, 1928 to November 27, 1935 he was on the teaching staff
of the 1st School of Dentistry in Harbin.

He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in December 1935
and in January 1936 established his office at the Hamilton
House. In October 1937 he removed his office to it's
present address at Apt. 5, 309 Cardinal Mercier.

Mrs. Nadejda Yakovlevna NASONOFF, nee Nedelko, Russian,
was born in Pogranichnaya Station, Chinese Eastern Railway
on October 10, 1901. In December 1931 she graduated from
the 1st School of Dentistry in Harbin and has since been
working as an assistant to Mr. Nasonoff.

Mr. and Mrs. Nasonoff are reported to have been living
as a husband and wife since 1923. They were legally married
in Shanghai in February 1937.

They are registered at the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
118/1 Moulmein Road and are in possession of passport No.17247,
issued on November 10, 1937 by the Police Bureau of the City
Government of Shanghai.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
detrimental to the characters of the above persons.

D.C.(Special Branch)
**〔此处为手写签名〕**
D.P.S.

（左侧边缘手写批注：382 8/11）

由 D.P.S. Pavloff 制作 转呈者 **〔此处转录不清〕**

Evgeny Alexandrovitch NASONOFF，俄国人，1896年2月17日出生于俄罗斯彼尔姆。据报他于1920年离开俄罗斯，随后居住在哈尔滨。1927年12月，他毕业于哈尔滨第一牙科学校，并成为一名牙科医生。1932年12月，他获得哈尔滨第二牙科学校颁发的牙科医生文凭。从1928年11月3日至1935年11月27日，他在哈尔滨第一牙科学校任教。

他于1935年12月从哈尔滨抵达上海，并于1936年1月在汉密尔顿大厦（Hamilton House）设立诊所。1937年10月，他将诊所迁至目前的地址：麦兰尼路（Cardinal Mercier）309号5室。

Nadejda Yakovlevna NASONOFF 夫人，娘家姓 Nedelko，俄国人，1901年10月10日出生于中东铁路边境站（Pogranichnaya Station）。1931年12月，她毕业于哈尔滨第一牙科学校，此后一直担任 Nasonoff 先生的助手。

据报 Nasonoff 夫妇自1923年起以夫妻名义共同生活。他们于1937年2月在上海正式结婚。

他们在莫尔缅路（Moulmein Road）118/1号的俄国侨民委员会登记，并持有上海市政府警察局于1937年11月10日签发的第17247号护照。

在工部局警务处的记录中，没有任何不利于上述人员品行的内容。

D.C.（特务科）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ________
C. S. 6, Special Branch. XXXXX
REPORT
Date August 15, 1939.

Subject Albert BANDMANN - Request for Police to issue document ensuring
free landing in Shanghai.

Made by ________ and ________________________ Forwarded by D.S.I. Wittinsky

On the 15-8-39 a.m. Mr. Albert Bandmann,
German-Jew, merchant, born in Hamburg, Germany, on the
23-8-1900, residing at 461 Avenue Joffre, Flat 68,
came to this office and enquired whether it were
possible for the Municipal Police to issue him with an
official document, to show that he is not a refugee
from Germany but a bona-fide merchant and resident of
Shanghai for the past 12 years.

Mr. Bandmann is the proprietor of a business
concern known as "Albert Bandmann", at 53 Foochow Road,
conducting business for over 10 years in Shanghai as
a Manufacturer's Representative, having the local agency
for several British, Netherlands and German woolen and
textile companies (see S.B. D.6264/201). He stated,
that he intends to sail on the 18-8-39 on the s.s.
"Wosang" for a short business trip to Hongkong and is
afraid, that on his return he would encounter difficult-
ies when landing owing to the recently enforced restrict-
ions against Jewish refugees.

Attached is a letter, addressed to the
Shanghai Municipal Council, brought by Mr. Bandmann to
this office.

O. Wittinsky
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

1939年8月15日上午，Albert Bandmann 先生，德籍犹太人，商人，1900年8月23日出生于德国汉堡，居住于霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）461号68室，来到本办公室询问，工部局警务处是否可能向他签发一份官方文件，以证明他并非来自德国的难民，而是一名真正的商人，且已在上海居住了12年。

Bandmann 先生是位于福州路53号、名为“Albert Bandmann”的商号的所有人，他在上海作为制造商代表开展业务已超过10年，代理几家英国、荷兰和德国羊毛及纺织公司的本地业务（参见特务科档案 D.6264/201）。他表示，他打算于1939年8月18日乘坐“沃桑”号（s.s. "Wosang"）轮船前往香港进行短期商务旅行，并担心由于最近针对犹太难民实施的限制措施，他在返回时登陆会遇到困难。

随函附上 Bandmann 先生带到本办公室的一封致上海公共租界工部局的信件。

O. Wittinsky

According to a report in the Shanghai "Evening Post"
of Monday, August 14th, the S.M.C. has reached a decision not

Made by D. S. Pitts. Forwarded by C. Crawford. L. S.

During the morning of November 30, 1938, Mr.
Albert BANDMANN, German of Jewish origin, came to this
office and enquired whether it were possible for the
Municipal Police to officially endorse the attached letter
of agreement to show that the firm known as ALBERT
BANDMANN was recognized as a legitimate trading concern.
This letter is required by the German home authorities
to effect the release from a concentration camp near
Hamburg of a German Jew named Paul ROMANN who is a former
university friend of Mr. Bandmann. As Jews are not
permitted to remove currency from the Reich in any form,
Romann is being offered a position by Mr. Bandmann, who
is of the opinion that the contract will be sufficient
for the German authorities not only to release his
friend but to supply him with the necessary travel papers
enabling him to make the journey from Hamburg to Shanghai.
Translation of the attached communication reads:

LETTER OF AGREEMENT

"I, the undersigned, Albert BANDMANN, of 53
Foochow Road, Shanghai, hereby state that Mr. Paul
Romann of 37 Isestrasse, Hamburg 13, is engaged by
me at Shanghai $150 per month plus commission,
according to a special agreement to be reached, for
a probationary period of three months as a textile
salesman in Shanghai and outports. The final
details of the agreement will be settled after the
termination of the probationary period which will
commence from the time of arrival in Shanghai of
Mr. Romann. The expenses for the journey will
be borne by Mr. Romann.

Signed: Albert Bandmann."

conducting business in Shanghai as a Manufacturer's
Representative, having the local agency for several

主题：Albert BANDMANN - 请求警方对其公司与目前被拘留在德国的 Paul ROMANN 之间的协议进行背书。
由 D. S. Pitts 制作。转呈者 C. Crawford. L. S.

1938年11月30日上午，Albert BANDMANN 先生，德籍犹太人，来到本办公室询问，工部局警务处是否可能正式背书所附的协议信函，以表明名为 ALBERT BANDMANN 的商号被认可为合法的贸易机构。德国国内当局需要这封信件，以便释放关押在汉堡附近集中营的一名名为 Paul ROMANN 的德国犹太人，他是 Bandmann 先生以前的大学朋友。由于不允许犹太人以任何形式将货币带出帝国，Bandmann 先生向 Romann 提供了一个职位，他认为该合同足以让德国当局不仅释放他的朋友，还为他提供必要的旅行证件，使他能够从汉堡前往上海。所附通信的译文如下：

协议信函

“本人，下述签署人 Albert BANDMANN，住址上海福州路53号，特此声明，我雇佣 Hamburg 13, Isestrasse 37号的 Paul Romann 先生，月薪上海币150元外加佣金，根据将要达成的特别协议，在上海及外埠担任纺织品销售员，试用期为三个月。协议的最终细节将在试用期结束后确定，试用期从 Romann 先生抵达上海之时开始。旅费由 Romann 先生承担。

签署：Albert Bandmann。”

Albert Bandmann 在上海作为制造商代表开展业务已超过十年，代理几家

Constantin Constantinovich FEDOSSEYEFF, Russian,
was born on June 1, 1904 at Rostov-on-Don, Russia. According
to his own statement, he left Russia for Manchuria in 1921
and for the following ten years resided in Harbin. In 1926
he is reported to have graduated from the Harbin Polytechnic
Institute (Civil Engineering Department), after which he
was employed with the Chinese Eastern Railway for about five
years.

    In December, 1931 he arrived in Shanghai from
Harbin. Here he is known to have been employed in his
professional capacity with Meyer Construction Corporation,
Sassoon House (from 29.3.32 to 1.4.33), Republic Land
Investment Co., 21 Yuen Ming Yuen Road (July, 1933 to
October, 1934), Leonard-Veysseyere-Kruze, 461 Avenue Joffre
(January to June, 1935) and Unit Furniture Co., 213-A
Grosvenor Gardens, Route Cardinal Mercier (May, 1936 to
April, 1937). In July, 1937 he was engaged by Siemens
China Co., 233 Nanking Road, as an assistant civil engineer
at the construction of a hydro-electric power plant at
Amichow, Yunnan Province. Upon expiration of his agree-
ment with the latter firm he returned to Shanghai on
21.12.38 in the s.s. "Shantung".

    It appears that while in Harbin Fedosseveff applied
for a Soviet passport in order, he stated, to keep his
employment with the Chinese Eastern Railway. In Shanghai
he is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
Moulmein Road, and the Shanghai City Government Police
Bureau (Reg. 13816). At present he resides at 51 Route

Constantin Constantinovich FEDOSSEYEFF，俄国人，1904年6月1日出生于俄罗斯顿河畔罗斯托夫。据他自己陈述，他于1921年离开俄罗斯前往满洲，并在随后的十年里居住在哈尔滨。据报他于1926年毕业于哈尔滨工业大学（土木工程系），之后在中东铁路工作了约五年。

    1931年12月，他从哈尔滨抵达上海。在此地，已知他以专业身份受雇于以下机构：迈耶建筑公司（Meyer Construction Corporation），沙逊大厦（1932年3月29日至1933年4月1日）；共和置业公司（Republic Land Investment Co.），圆明园路21号（1933年7月至1934年10月）；Leonard-Veysseyere-Kruze 公司，霞飞路461号（1935年1月至6月）；联合家具公司（Unit Furniture Co.），格罗夫纳花园路（Grosvenor Gardens）213-A号，麦兰尼路（Route Cardinal Mercier）（1936年5月至1937年4月）。1937年7月，他被西门子中国公司（Siemens China Co.），南京路233号，聘为助理土木工程师，参与云南省阿迷州（Amichow）水电站的建设。在与该公司的合同期满后，他于1938年12月21日乘坐“山东”号（s.s. "Shantung"）轮船返回上海。

    看来在哈尔滨期间，Fedosseveff 曾申请苏联护照，据他说，是为了保留其中东铁路的工作。在上海，他在莫尔缅路（Moulmein Road）的俄国侨民委员会和上海市政府警察局登记（注册号 13816）。目前他居住在格鲁希路（Route

Eduard Klausse

Shanghai, Dec. 31st, 1938

To the
Secretary
Shanghai Municipal Police
Local.

Dear Sir,

I, the undersigned Eduard KLAUSS, printer and compositor
German citizen, born June 25th, 1904 at Vienna, resident of
Shanghai 129, Avenue Haig, House 11 asks the hon. Secretary of
the S.M.P. for a certificate of good conduct for the purpose
of travelling to Australia.

Yours sincerely

Eduard Klauss

TELEPHONE DALY 3187

PATRICK J. McCAFFREY
ATTORNEY AT LAW
516-17 MARINER TOWER
606 W. WISCONSIN AVENUE
MILWAUKEE, WIS.

Nov. 4, 1938.

Chief of Police,
International Settlement,
Shanghai, China.

Dear Sir:

Re: Wilhelm Nicolaas du Mee,
known as William du Mee.

My client, Mr. du Mee, a Dutch subject, is attempting
to qualify for citizenship here.

He lived in Shanghai from July 1921 until the 1st of
February, 1924, where he was first employed as Manager
of the Shanghai Motors & Engineering Works, 26 Yulin Road,
and later by the Texas Company.

Mr. du Mee is required by the Immigration authorities here
to produce a statement from the Shanghai Police Department,
International Settlement, as to whether he has any police
record. He needs this document in a hurry because there is
little time left.

I will be most grateful if you will send a statement to me
at the above address at your earliest convenience.

Yours very truly,
〔此处为手写签名〕

中国上海。

尊敬的先生：

事由：威廉·尼古拉斯·杜·梅，
又名威廉·杜·梅。

我的客户杜·梅先生，系荷兰籍国民，正试图在此获得公民资格。

他于 1921 年 7 月至 1924 年 2 月 1 日期间居住在上海，起初受雇于玉林路 26 号的上海汽车与工程公司（Shanghai Motors & Engineering Works）担任经理，后来受雇于德士古公司（Texas Company）。

此地的移民局当局要求杜·梅先生提供一份来自上海国际租界警察局的陈述，说明他是否有警务记录。他急需此文件，因为剩余时间不多。

如蒙阁下尽早将陈述寄至上述地址，本人将不胜感激。

此致，
〔此处为手写签名〕

PJMcC:GP
